text: hey the '/' route for hmsc-int, i want to change it up. first thing lets write a quick playbook so we can organize these thoughts before we dive in. so, i want t he app to start up and have a window up and running instantly. currently the / route loads an entire games map and the startup time between me pressing enter to start the program in my terminal and the window finally being open and i can do anything is always growing and growing and it just sucks. we end it. the / route becomes a dashboard of sorts, and we want to ideally start pulling in data to be ready to serve, however, i also am thinking that it might be better to treat the data delivery as a sub process and not the same thread so that it can be hot and ready to go like a little ceasers pizza, now im not quite sure if that would actually help but at least first thigns first, the / route needs a change. now, for the content that happen to currently be on the / route. the layout of it is going to do a radical change. because as more and more things have just grown, its a fuckin mess and really i use 1 panel of it >90% or more of t he time so the distribution of space is horrible in the current approach. that is something we need to look at actual possible approaches to consider that dont make it feel like you have to be the autistic guy who wrote the program and knows how it works and no one else can even infer from it.

resolution: Wrote DASHBOARD_PLAYBOOK.md organizing the / route rework into three threads before any code, per the user's 'playbook first' ask.
